name: Thymocles
bio: Thymocles is one of the named epigrammatists whose short poems are preserved in the Greek Anthology. Paton's Index of Authors says the poet's date is unknown.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fourth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XII: 32.

poems.title: Book XII, 32
poems.author: Thymocles
poems.text: Thou rememberest, I trust, thou rememberest the time when I spoke to thee the holy verse, “ Beauty is fairest and beauty is nimblest.” Not the fleetest bird in the sky shall outstrip beauty. Look, now, how all thy blossoms are shed on the earth.
